messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic optimization certifying area lower bounds via semidefinite relaxation

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square has a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/126, and this value is certified by a degree-4 sum-of-squares semidefinite relaxation over the pairwise distance variables. The relaxation is tight because the primal optimality conditions correspond to a graph-theoretic rigidity certificate: the 286 triangle-area polynomials admit a rational SOS certificate modulo the Cayley–Menger constraints, proving every triple spans at least 1/126. The unique extremal configuration (up to symmetry) is an algebraic perturbation of the triangular lattice in which all 13 coordinates lie in the number field defined by this SOS certificate."}
